tools.name: find_town
tools.description: Look up a US town, city, village, borough, township or county in the On the Books library of local codes (9,700+ municipalities, all 50 states) and get its id for the other tools. No sign-in needed. Read-only.

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Search one town's municipal code (its local ordinances) by keyword and get the matching passages in the code's own words, each with its chapter and section, plus the link to the town's official published code. tools.name: compare
tools.description: Ask the same question of 2 or 3 towns and get one comparison, each town's rule cited to its own code. Needs a connected pass (sign in) or a key; counts one question per town. Takes 20–60 seconds. Changes nothing except that count.
